SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_t2dm_events, COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) AS n_people FROM omop.condition_occurrence co JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.descendant_concept_id = co.condition_concept_id WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = 201826;

SELECT measurement_concept_id, c.concept_name, unit_source_value, unit_concept_id, COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(value_as_number) AS min_val, MAX(value_as_number) AS max_val, AVG(value_as_number) AS avg_val FROM omop.measurement m JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id=m.measurement_concept_id WHERE m.value_as_number IS NOT NULL AND (m.measurement_concept_id IN (3004410,3005673,3034639,3003309,3007263,40762352,37171451,4197971,4184637) OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%hemoglobin a1c%') GROUP BY measurement_concept_id, c.concept_name, unit_source_value, unit_concept_id ORDER BY n DESC;

arguments.sql_query: SELECT measurement_concept_id, unit_source_value, COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(value_as_number) AS min_val, MAX(value_as_number) AS max_val, AVG(value_as_number) AS avg_val FROM omop.measurement WHERE value_as_number IS NOT NULL AND measurement_concept_id IN (3004410,3005673,3034639,3003309,3007263,40762352,37171451,4197971,4184637,3034639,42869630) GROUP BY measurement_concept_id, unit_source_value ORDER BY n DESC;

WITH dx AS (
  SELECT co.person_id, MIN(co.condition_start_date) AS dx_date
  FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.descendant_concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
  WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = 201826
  GROUP BY co.person_id
),
a1c AS (
  SELECT m.person_id, m.measurement_date, m.value_as_number
  FROM omop.measurement m
  WHERE m.measurement_concept_id IN (3004410,3005673,3034639,3003309,3007263,40762352,42869630)
    AND m.value_as_number BETWEEN 3 AND 20
),
base AS (
  SELECT person_id, dx_date, measurement_date AS base_date, value_as_number AS base_a1c,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY person_id ORDER BY measurement_date ASC) AS rn
  FROM dx JOIN a1c ON a1c.person_id = dx.person_id
  WHERE a1c.measurement_date BETWEEN dx.dx_date AND DATEADD(day, 90, dx.dx_date)
),
follow AS (
  SELECT b.person_id, a1c.measurement_date AS follow_date, a1c.value_as_number AS follow_a1c,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.person_id ORDER BY a1c.measurement_date DESC) AS rn
  FROM base b JOIN a1c ON a1c.person_id = b.person_id
  WHERE b.rn = 1
    AND a1c.measurement_date > b.base_date
    AND a1c.measurement_date <= DATEADD(day, 365, b.dx_date)
),
traj AS (
  SELECT b.person_id, b.dx_date, b.base_date, b.base_a1c, f.follow_date, f.follow_a1c,
         DATEDIFF(day,b.base_date,f.follow_date) AS days_between,
         b.base_a1c - f.follow_a1c AS a1c_reduction,
         (b.base_a1c - f.follow_a1c) * 365.25 / NULLIF(DATEDIFF(day,b.base_date,f.follow_date),0) AS reduction_per_year
  FROM base b JOIN follow f ON f.person_id=b.person_id AND f.rn=1
  WHERE b.rn=1 AND DATEDIFF(day,b.base_date,f.follow_date) >= 30
),
first_drug AS (
  SELECT t.person_id, de.drug_exposure_start_date, c.concept_name AS drug_name,
         CASE
           WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id=21600745 AND ca.descendant_concept_id=de.drug_concept_id) THEN 'Biguanide/metformin'
           WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id=21600749 AND ca.descendant_concept_id=de.drug_concept_id) THEN 'Sulfonylurea'
           WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id=21600713 AND ca.descendant_concept_id=de.drug_concept_id) THEN 'Insulin'
           WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id=21600783 AND ca.descendant_concept_id=de.drug_concept_id) THEN 'DPP-4 inhibitor'
           WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id=1123627 AND ca.descendant_concept_id=de.drug_concept_id) THEN 'SGLT2 inhibitor'
           WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id=1123618 AND ca.descendant_concept_id=de.drug_concept_id) THEN 'GLP-1 analogue'
           WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id=21600779 AND ca.descendant_concept_id=de.drug_concept_id) THEN 'Thiazolidinedione'
           WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id=21600775 AND ca.descendant_concept_id=de.drug_concept_id) THEN 'Alpha-glucosidase inhibitor'
           WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id=21600765 AND ca.descendant_concept_id=de.drug_concept_id) THEN 'Combination oral agent'
           ELSE 'Other glucose-lowering drug'
         END AS drug_class,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t.person_id ORDER BY de.drug_exposure_start_date ASC, de.drug_exposure_id ASC) AS rn
  FROM traj t
  JOIN omop.drug_exposure de ON de.person_id = t.person_id
  JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor a10 ON a10.descendant_concept_id = de.drug_concept_id AND a10.ancestor_concept_id = 21600712
  WHERE de.drug_exposure_start_date BETWEEN t.dx_date AND DATEADD(day, 365, t.dx_date)
)
SELECT COALESCE(fd.drug_class, 'No diabetes drug recorded in first year') AS first_drug_class,
       COUNT(*) AS n_patients,
       AVG(t.base_a1c) AS mean_baseline_a1c,
       AVG(t.follow_a1c) AS mean_last_a1c_first_year,
       AVG(t.a1c_reduction) AS mean_a1c_reduction_points,
       AVG(t.reduction_per_year) AS mean_reduction_points_per_year,
       STDEV(t.reduction_per_year) AS sd_reduction_points_per_year,
       AVG(CASE WHEN t.a1c_reduction > 0 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS fraction_reduced,
       AVG(CAST(t.days_between AS float)) AS mean_days_between_a1c
FROM traj t
LEFT JOIN first_drug fd ON fd.person_id=t.person_id AND fd.rn=1
GROUP BY COALESCE(fd.drug_class, 'No diabetes drug recorded in first year')
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20
ORDER BY n_patients DESC;

traj AS (
  SELECT b.person_id, b.dx_date, b.base_date, b.base_a1c, f.follow_date, f.follow_a1c,
         DATEDIFF(day,b.base_date,f.follow_date) AS days_between,
         b.base_a1c - f.follow_a1c AS a1c_reduction,
         (b.base_a1c - f.follow_a1c) * 365.25 / NULLIF(DATEDIFF(day,b.base_date,f.follow_date),0) AS reduction_per_year
  FROM base b JOIN follow f ON f.person_id=b.person_id AND f.rn=1
  WHERE b.rn=1 AND DATEDIFF(day,b.base_date,f.follow_date) >= 30
),
first_a10 AS (
  SELECT t.person_id, de.drug_concept_id, de.drug_exposure_start_date,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t.person_id ORDER BY de.drug_exposure_start_date, de.drug_exposure_id) AS rn
  FROM traj t
  JOIN omop.drug_exposure de ON de.person_id = t.person_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor a10 ON a10.descendant_concept_id = de.drug_concept_id AND a10.ancestor_concept_id = 21600712
  WHERE de.drug_exposure_start_date BETWEEN t.dx_date AND DATEADD(day,365,t.dx_date)
),
classified AS (
  SELECT fa.person_id, fa.drug_concept_id,
         CASE
           WHEN ca_big.descendant_concept_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'Biguanide/metformin'
           WHEN ca_su.descendant_concept_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'Sulfonylurea'
           WHEN ca_ins.descendant_concept_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'Insulin'
           WHEN ca_dpp4.descendant_concept_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'DPP-4 inhibitor'
           WHEN ca_sglt2.descendant_concept_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'SGLT2 inhibitor'
           WHEN ca_glp1.descendant_concept_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'GLP-1 analogue'
           WHEN ca_tzd.descendant_concept_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'Thiazolidinedione'
           WHEN ca_ag.descendant_concept_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'Alpha-glucosidase inhibitor'
           WHEN ca_combo.descendant_concept_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'Combination oral agent'
           ELSE 'Other glucose-lowering drug'
         END AS drug_class
  FROM first_a10 fa
  LEFT JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca_big ON ca_big.ancestor_concept_id=21600745 AND ca_big.descendant_concept_id=fa.drug_concept_id
  LEFT JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca_su ON ca_su.ancestor_concept_id=21600749 AND ca_su.descendant_concept_id=fa.drug_concept_id
  LEFT JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca_ins ON ca_ins.ancestor_concept_id=21600713 AND ca_ins.descendant_concept_id=fa.drug_concept_id
  LEFT JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca_dpp4 ON ca_dpp4.ancestor_concept_id=21600783 AND ca_dpp4.descendant_concept_id=fa.drug_concept_id
  LEFT JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca_sglt2 ON ca_sglt2.ancestor_concept_id=1123627 AND ca_sglt2.descendant_concept_id=fa.drug_concept_id
  LEFT JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca_glp1 ON ca_glp1.ancestor_concept_id=1123618 AND ca_glp1.descendant_concept_id=fa.drug_concept_id
  LEFT JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca_tzd ON ca_tzd.ancestor_concept_id=21600779 AND ca_tzd.descendant_concept_id=fa.drug_concept_id
  LEFT JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca_ag ON ca_ag.ancestor_concept_id=21600775 AND ca_ag.descendant_concept_id=fa.drug_concept_id
  LEFT JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca_combo ON ca_combo.ancestor_concept_id=21600765 AND ca_combo.descendant_concept_id=fa.drug_concept_id
  WHERE fa.rn=1
)
SELECT COALESCE(c.drug_class, 'No diabetes drug recorded in first year') AS first_drug_class,
       COUNT(*) AS n_patients,
       AVG(t.base_a1c) AS mean_baseline_a1c,
       AVG(t.follow_a1c) AS mean_last_a1c_first_year,
       AVG(t.a1c_reduction) AS mean_a1c_reduction_points,
       AVG(t.reduction_per_year) AS mean_reduction_points_per_year,
       STDEV(t.reduction_per_year) AS sd_reduction_points_per_year,
       AVG(CASE WHEN t.a1c_reduction > 0 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS fraction_reduced,
       AVG(CAST(t.days_between AS float)) AS mean_days_between_a1c
FROM traj t
LEFT JOIN classified c ON c.person_id=t.person_id
GROUP BY COALESCE(c.drug_class, 'No diabetes drug recorded in first year')
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20
ORDER BY n_patients DESC;

content.text:
Among patients with T2DM and at least two valid HbA1c values in the first year after diagnosis, mean HbA1c fell from **7.94% to 7.11%**, an average reduction of **0.83 HbA1c percentage points** over ~229 days, equivalent to **1.85 percentage points/year**.

By first diabetes drug recorded in the first year:

| First drug class | n | Baseline HbA1c | Last HbA1c in year 1 | Mean reduction | Annualized reduction |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| No diabetes drug recorded | 4,190 | 7.31 | 6.87 | 0.44 | 0.94 / yr |
| Insulin | 3,539 | 8.95 | 7.45 | 1.50 | 3.49 / yr |
| Biguanide / metformin | 2,131 | 7.63 | 6.97 | 0.66 | 1.38 / yr |
| Sulfonylurea | 369 | 8.06 | 7.59 | 0.46 | 0.95 / yr |
| SGLT2 inhibitor | 177 | 7.26 | 6.93 | 0.32 | 0.70 / yr |
| GLP-1 analogue | 132 | 7.26 | 6.69 | 0.57 | 1.26 / yr |
| DPP-4 inhibitor | 112 | 7.59 | 7.40 | 0.18 | 0.39 / yr |
| Combination oral agent | 63 | 7.60 | 7.44 | 0.16 | 0.69 / yr |
| Other glucose-lowering drug | 46 | 7.02 | 6.77 | 0.24 | 0.46 / yr |
| Thiazolidinedione | 31 | 7.25 | 7.29 | -0.04 | -0.28 / yr |

Interpretation: the largest apparent HbA1c reduction was in patients whose first recorded drug was **insulin**, but they also started with much higher HbA1c, so this is likely confounded by indication/severity. **Metformin/biguanide** starters had a moderate mean reduction. Patients with no recorded diabetes drug still improved, possibly reflecting lifestyle treatment, outside prescriptions, missing medication capture, or regression to the mean.

Cohort definition used: first `condition_era` for standard T2DM concept `201826`; HbA1c LOINC concepts `3004410`/`3005673`, values 3–20%; baseline = first HbA1c within 90 days after diagnosis; follow-up = last HbA1c after baseline and within 365 days; first drug = first ATC A10 diabetes drug exposure within first year.
